title: Anki shows dollar signs instead of math? Here's the fix
description: Anki's MathJax doesn't read $…$. Learn why AI-generated formulas show raw dollar signs in Anki and convert them to \( … \) automatically, for free.
h1: Why Anki shows dollar signs instead of your formulas
sub: AI tools write math as $…$. Anki's MathJax only understands \( … \) and \[ … \]. Paste your cards above and the formulas are converted before they reach Anki.

paragraphs: Anki renders math with MathJax, using \( … \) for inline formulas and \[ … \] for formulas on their own line. Dollar signs are not enabled by default, so a card that contains $E = mc^2$ shows the dollars and the raw code.
ChatGPT, Claude and most other assistants write math with dollar signs because that is the usual Markdown convention. The mismatch is the whole problem.

Paste the AI's answer into the tool on this page with the math option ticked. Inline $…$ becomes \( … \) and $$…$$ becomes \[ … \]. Amounts such as $5 or $10 are left alone, because a price is not a formula.

For cards already in your collection, Anki's Find and Replace can work with regular expressions. It is powerful but a wrong pattern can damage many notes at once, so back up your collection before trying it.
list: Already correct \( … \) formulas are kept as they are.
